questions.q: What is the ratio of Boys of School A & Girls of School B to Boys of School C & Girls of School D?
questions.solution: Girls = total - boys: A 8, B 24, C 4, D 16. Boys A + girls B = 52 + 24 = 76; boys C + girls D = 36 + 16 = 52. Ratio = 76 : 52 = 19 : 13. **Answer: 19:13**
questions.passage: Directions: Study the graph carefully and answer the questions given below. The line graph shows the number of boys and girls together and the number of boys in four schools A, B, C and D. School A: total students 60, boys 52. School B: total students 54, boys 30. School C: total students 40, boys 36. School D: total students 72, boys 56.

questions.q: The number of boys in School C is what percent of the total number of students in School A?
questions.solution: Boys in C = 36 and total students in A = 60. Required percentage = 36/60 x 100 = 60%. **Answer: 60%**

questions.q: If the number of boys in School D increases by 25% and the number of girls in School D decreases by 25%, what will be the new total number of students in School D?
questions.solution: School D has 56 boys and 16 girls. New boys = 56 x 1.25 = 70 and new girls = 16 x 0.75 = 12. New total = 70 + 12 = 82. **Answer: 82**

questions.q: On a particular day, 25% of the boys in School A remained absent while all the girls were present. On the same day, 50% of the girls in School C remained absent while all the boys were present. What is the total number of students present in School A and School C combined on that day?
questions.solution: Present in A = 75% of 52 boys + all 8 girls = 39 + 8 = 47. Present in C = all 36 boys + 50% of 4 girls = 36 + 2 = 38. Total present = 47 + 38 = 85. **Answer: 85**

questions.q: What is the average number of girls across all four schools (A, B, C and D)?
questions.solution: Girls: A 8, B 24, C 4, D 16, so total girls = 52. Average = 52/4 = 13. **Answer: 13**

questions.q: What is the ratio of apples sold by Shop C to the total mangoes sold by Shop A and Shop B together?
questions.solution: For each shop, 40% of the average means 0.2 x (apples + mangoes), and the difference is apples - mangoes. So A: 70 apples, 30 mangoes; B: 90, 60; C: 258, 242; D: 135, 115. Required ratio = apples of C : mangoes of (A + B) = 258 : (30 + 60) = 258 : 90 = 43 : 15. **Answer: 43:15**
questions.passage: Directions: Study the table carefully and answer the questions given below. The table shows 40% of the average number of apples and mangoes sold by four shops, and the difference between the number of apples and mangoes sold by them (Apples > Mangoes in every shop). Shop A: 40% of average = 20, difference = 40. Shop B: 40% of average = 30, difference = 30. Shop C: 40% of average = 100, difference = 16. Shop D: 40% of average = 50, difference = 20.

questions.q: The total number of apples and mangoes sold by Shop A and Shop B together is what percent of the total number of apples and mangoes sold by Shop C?
questions.solution: A + B fruits = 100 + 150 = 250; C fruits = 500. Required percentage = 250/500 x 100 = 50%. **Answer: 50%**

questions.q: If the apples sold by Shop A increase by 30% and the mangoes sold by Shop A decrease by 20%, what will be the new total (apples + mangoes) sold by Shop A?
questions.solution: Shop A sells 70 apples and 30 mangoes. New apples = 70 x 1.3 = 91 and new mangoes = 30 x 0.8 = 24. New total = 91 + 24 = 115. **Answer: 115**

questions.q: If the cost price of an apple and a mango is Rs. 5 and Rs. 8 respectively, and apples are sold at a 10% profit while mangoes are sold at a 25% profit, find the total profit earned by Shop B after selling all the fruits
questions.solution: Shop B sells 90 apples and 60 mangoes. Profit on apples = 90 x 5 x 10% = 45 and on mangoes = 60 x 8 x 25% = 120. Total profit = 45 + 120 = 165. **Answer: 165**

18 men and 12 women can complete a piece of work in 24 days. After 6 men leave and 8 women join, the new group completes 50% of the same work in 12 days. Find the time taken by 30 women to complete 2.5 times the same work
questions.solution: Let the 12-day work of 12 men and 20 women equal half the work of 18 men and 12 women in 24 days: 12(12M + 20W) = 12(18M + 12W), giving 6M = 8W, so M = 4W/3. Total work = 24(18 x 4/3 + 12)W = 864W. Twice-and-a-half of it = 2160W, which 30 women finish in 2160/30 = 72 days. **Answer: 72 days**

questions.q: Quantity I: A invests Rs 30,000 for 12 months. B invests Rs 45,000 after 4 months and remains till the end. Total profit is Rs 63,000. Find B's share. Quantity II: P invests Rs 48,000 for 12 months. Q invests Rs 36,000 but withdraws after 8 months. Total profit is Rs 60,000. Find Q's share
options: Quantity I = Quantity II or no relation
questions.solution: Quantity I: A = 30,000 x 12 = 3,60,000 and B = 45,000 x 8 = 3,60,000 - equal, so B gets 31,500. Quantity II: P = 48,000 x 12 = 5,76,000 and Q = 36,000 x 8 = 2,88,000, so Q gets 60,000 x 2,88,000/8,64,000 = 20,000. Since 31,500 > 20,000, Quantity I > Quantity II. **Answer: Quantity I > Quantity II**

questions.q: Quantity I: Vessel A contains milk and water in the ratio of 3 : 2. 10 liters of the mixture is transferred from Vessel A to Vessel B, which initially contains only pure milk. After the transfer, the ratio of milk to water in Vessel B becomes 11 : 2. Find the initial quantity of milk in Vessel B (in liters). Quantity II: A 48 L mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 5 : 3. If 12 L of the mixture is removed and replaced with pure milk, find the final quantity of milk (in liters)
options: Quantity I = Quantity II or no relation
questions.solution: Quantity I: 10 L of A's 3:2 mixture carries 6 L milk and 4 L water into B. (M + 6)/4 = 11/2 gives M = 16 L. Quantity II: the 48 L vessel has 30 L milk; removing 12 L of mixture takes away 7.5 L milk, leaving 22.5 L, then adding 12 L milk gives 34.5 L. Since 16 < 34.5, Quantity I < Quantity II. **Answer: Quantity I < Quantity II**

questions.q: Quantity I: A shopkeeper marks an article 80% above cost price and allows a discount of 25%. If the marked price is Rs 7,200, find the selling price. Quantity II: A trader purchases an article for Rs 4,000 and sells it at a profit of 35%. Find the selling price
options: Quantity I = Quantity II or no relation
questions.solution: Quantity I: marked price 7,200 is 1.8 times cost, so cost = 4,000 and selling price = 7,200 x 0.75 = 5,400. Quantity II: selling price = 4,000 x 1.35 = 5,400. The two quantities are equal. **Answer: Quantity I = Quantity II or no relation**

questions.q: The total cost price of two articles A and B is Rs. 700. Both articles are marked up by 60% on their respective cost prices. The marked price of Article A is Rs. 160 less than the marked price of Article B. Find the cost price of Article A
questions.solution: Marked prices are 1.6 times the cost prices, and 1.6A = 1.6B - 160, so A = B - 100. With A + B = 700, B = 400 and A = 300. Cost price of Article A = Rs. 300. **Answer: Rs. 300**

questions.q: The length of a rectangle is 10 cm more than its breadth. The perimeter of the rectangle is 68 cm. If the breadth of the rectangle is 2 cm less than the side of a square, find the area of the square
questions.solution: Length + breadth = 68/2 = 34 and length = breadth + 10, so breadth = 12 cm. The square's side = 12 + 2 = 14 cm, so area = 14^2 = 196 cm^2. **Answer: 196 cm²**

questions.q: Vessel A contains 60 liters of milk and water in the ratio 3 : 2, while Vessel B contains 40 liters of pure water. 10 liters of mixture is taken out from Vessel A and poured into Vessel B. Find the ratio of milk to water in Vessel B after the transfer
questions.solution: Vessel A's 10 L outflow carries milk and water in 3:2, i.e. 6 L milk and 4 L water. Vessel B then has 6 L milk and 40 + 4 = 44 L water, so the ratio = 6 : 44 = 3 : 22. **Answer: 3 : 22**

questions.q: Set A contains 5 consecutive multiples of 4, while Set B contains 4 consecutive multiples of 6. The average of Set A is 32, and the average of Set B is 33. Find the difference between the largest number of Set B and the smallest number of Set A
questions.solution: Set A's average 32 is its middle term, so the smallest is 32 - 2 x 4 = 24. Set B's average 33 is midway between the 2nd and 3rd terms, so the largest is 33 + 9 = 42. Difference = 42 - 24 = 18. **Answer: 18**

questions.q: The ratio of the speed of a car to a bike is 2 : 3. The distance covered by the car in 3 hours is 90 km less than the distance covered by the bike in 4 hours. Find the distance covered by the car in 5 hours
questions.solution: Let speeds be 2v and 3v. Then 3(2v) = 4(3v) - 90, so 6v = 90 and v = 15. Car's speed = 30 km/h, so distance in 5 h = 150 km. **Answer: 150 km**

questions.q: The length of Train A is 300 m, while the length of Train B is 276 m. Train A and Train B cross a pole in 20 sec and 23 sec, respectively. If the ratio of the speed of Train A to Train B is 15 : 12, then find the time taken by the two trains to cross each other when they are moving in opposite directions
questions.solution: Train A's speed = 300/20 = 15 m/s and B's = 276/23 = 12 m/s, matching the 15:12 ratio. Crossing each other in opposite directions covers 300 + 276 = 576 m at 27 m/s, taking 576/27 = 21 1/3 seconds. **Answer: 21 1/3 sec**

questions.q: The product of two digits is 12. If the unit digit is increased by 1, the product becomes 16. Find the difference between the two digits
questions.solution: If the digits are a and b, ab = 12 and a(b + 1) = 16, so a = 16 - 12 = 4 and b = 3. Difference = 4 - 3 = 1. **Answer: 1**

questions.q: A started a business with an investment of Rs. 3000. After 6 months, B joined the business with an investment of Rs. X. B left the partnership 10 months before the end of the business. The partnership continued for a total of 24 months, and the total profit earned was Rs. 25,000. If B received 20% of the total profit, then find A's profit share
questions.solution: B receives 20% of 25,000 = 5,000, so A receives 20,000. The investments only need to satisfy the ratio A : B = 4 : 1, i.e. 72,000 : 18,000 (X x 14 = 18,000), which is consistent. A's profit share = Rs. 20,000. **Answer: Rs. 20000**

questions.q: A man invested Rs. X at 20% p.a. compound interest for 2 years. The difference between the amount received and the interest earned is Rs. 1400. If he had invested Rs. (X + 500) at the same rate and for the same period, then find the interest he would have received
questions.solution: Amount - interest = principal, so the principal X = Rs. 1,400. New principal = 1,400 + 500 = 1,900. At 20% p.a. for 2 years the CI factor is 1.2 x 1.2 = 1.44, so interest = 1,900 x 0.44 = Rs. 836. **Answer: Rs. 836**

questions.q: The ratio of the present ages of A and B is 4 : 5. The average of their present ages is 2 years less than the present age of C. The sum of the present ages of B and C is 40 years. Find the age of A after 4 years
questions.solution: Let A = 4x and B = 5x. Average = 4.5x = C - 2, so C = 4.5x + 2. B + C = 40 gives 5x + 4.5x + 2 = 40, so 9.5x = 38 and x = 4. A = 16, and after 4 years A = 20 years. **Answer: 20 years**

questions.q: The sum of the downstream speed and upstream speed of a boat is 20 km/h. The boat covers 120 km downstream and 68 km upstream in a total of 18 hours 30 minutes. If the speed of the stream is an integer, find the speed of the stream
questions.solution: Downstream + upstream = 20 km/h gives still-water speed 10 km/h. With stream speed s, 120/(10 + s) + 68/(10 - s) = 18.5. Testing integer s, s = 2 gives 120/12 + 68/8 = 10 + 8.5 = 18.5 hours, so the stream speed is 2 km/h. **Answer: 2 km/h**
questions.shortcut: d + u = 20 fixes still-water speed 10; test integer stream speeds in the time equation.

questions.q: 245.048 + 170.95 + 128.97 = ? + 249.11 What is the approximate value of (?) in the following questions?
?, 11, 34, 137, 686, 4117 Find the missing number in the following number series
questions.solution: Each term is multiplied by an increasing integer and increased by 1: 11 x 3 + 1 = 34, 34 x 4 + 1 = 137, 137 x 5 + 1 = 686, 686 x 6 + 1 = 4117. Working backwards, ? x 2 + 1 = 11, so ? = 5. **Answer: 5**

questions.q: 8000, ?, 480, 192, 96, 57.6 Find the missing number in the following number series
questions.solution: The multipliers form the descending pattern x0.6, x0.5, x0.4, x0.3, x0.2: 96 x 0.6 = 57.6, 192 x 0.5 = 96, 480 x 0.4 = 192. So ? x 0.3 = 480, giving ? = 1600 (and 8000 x 0.2 = 1600 checks). **Answer: 1600**

questions.q: 356, ?, 347, 338, 326, 311 Find the missing number in the following number series
questions.solution: The differences between consecutive terms are -3, -6, -9, -12, -15. Check: 356 - 3 = 353, 353 - 6 = 347, 347 - 9 = 338, 338 - 12 = 326, 326 - 15 = 311. So the missing term is 353. **Answer: 353**

questions.q: What will come in the place of question (?) mark in following number series: 43, ?, 56, 72, 97, 133
questions.solution: The differences are perfect squares: 43 + 4 = 47, 47 + 9 = 56, 56 + 16 = 72, 72 + 25 = 97, 97 + 36 = 133. So the missing term is 47. **Answer: 47**

questions.q: 50, 73, 44, 75, ?, 79 What will come in the place of question (?) mark in following number series
questions.solution: The differences between consecutive terms are +23, -29, +31, -37, +41 - successive primes with alternating signs. Check: 50 + 23 = 73, 73 - 29 = 44, 44 + 31 = 75, 75 - 37 = 38, 38 + 41 = 79. So the missing term is 38. **Answer: 38**
questions.shortcut: Add and subtract successive primes alternately.

questions.q: The length of train A is 400 meters and it running with the speed of 54 km/hr. Quantity I: Time taken by train A to cross another train B which length is 50% of the length of train A and it is running with 33.33% of the speed of train A. Quantity II: Time taken by train A to cross a platform which length 5/4th of the length of train A. In the given question, two quantities are given, one as ‘Quantity I’ and another as ‘Quantity II’. You have to determine relationship between two quantities and choose the appropriate option
options: Quantity I = Quantity II or No relation
questions.solution: Train A runs at 54 km/h = 15 m/s and B at 33.33% of that = 5 m/s with length 200 m. Crossing B (either direction) takes 600/20 = 30 s (opposite) or 600/10 = 60 s (same direction). Quantity II: platform length = 500 m, so time = (400 + 500)/15 = 60 s. In either case Quantity I <= Quantity II. **Answer: Quantity I ≤ Quantity II**
